scope: source inventory refreshed 2026-10-05 after catalogue-v4 and the focused interfaces-v7/v8 checkpoints. Source registration, bounded interface evidence, and ordinary CLI availability are distinct; the v7 SDK pass was interrupted on temporary budget and is not credited.
native_root: rust/cix-native/src/full_engine plus paq bridge/supervisor and generic engine
observed_dispatch_fact: The native tree has compiled full_engine catalogue/FullEngine provider and frame dispatch surfaces. Focused v7 tests and the SDK-only v8 rerun exercised bounded interfaces. The ordinary CLI/generic portfolio selector still contains no automatic call into full_engine catalogue/dispatch, so specialist routes remain unavailable to normal automatic CLI operation. Current selection.rs NativeExecutor calls core::encode_buffer/engine::encode with the fixed 64 KiB CIXG1 backend; it is not yet equivalent to the retained historical native BEST portfolio (CIXG2 whole, CIXM6 and external complete archives).

status_meanings.library_tested_unwired: compiled native library route with narrow recorded source-bound focused tests, but no ordinary CLI automatic selector/encoder integration; it is not a release qualification
